upstream.note: Source hashes identify the inspected files. The upstream checkout has local changes.

sources.adaptations: Adapted AtlasRegion and AtlasManifest. Added strict boundary validation, packed cw90 rotation support, trimmed source rect offsets, 9-slice metadata, and finite number checks. Removed unvalidated object lookups.

Adapted frame resolution math. Replaced unvalidated state.clock dependency with an injected active presentation clock. Added durationMs per frame, timeline tick conversion, and separated cosmetic clip events from gameplay timelines.

Replaced per-atlas bucketing that broke global transparent ordering. Implemented multi-texture batching (up to 4 atlas samplers per run) that preserves global interleaved draw order across atlases and foreign layer boundaries. Replaced localeCompare with fixed-codepoint sorting.

Adapted global Y-sorting. Replaced raw ascending Y with foot anchor depthKey = -footWorldY. Replaced localeCompare with deterministic fixed-codepoint comparison. Integrated layer rank and sub-band ordering.
Adapted orthographic frustum, pixel snap, and content-fit math. Added camera follow with deadzone and smoothing. Integrated DPR scaling.
Adapted 2D parallax offset formula. Preserved factorX/factorY math with explicit camera offset origin.
Adapted tile chunk partition logic. Added horizontal, vertical, and diagonal flip flags, animated tile frames, frustum culling per chunk, and mutable tile edit revisions.
Replaced rectangle merge output with closed boundary contours. Internal edges are removed. The caller creates Syncplay chain shapes.

Eliminated per-actor Texture.clone() calls. Replaced single-mesh per actor with shared instanced geometry. Removed state.clock.elapsedTime fallback in favor of explicit injected clock. Replaced React state updates per frame with imperative scene calls.
Adapted Cocos2d TexturePacker format 2 XML parsing. Preserves rotated (cw90), offset, and sourceSize fields. Validates all inputs to finite values.
Adapted uniform grid spritesheet UV calculations into canonical AtlasManifest format.
Integrated into parsePlistAtlasManifest. Corrected Cocos2d Y offset orientation and rotated dimension mapping.
Replaced individual mesh-per-actor and cropped texture clones with shared instanced multi-texture rendering on Three.js instanced meshes. Bound monotonic renderOrder.
Reused cosmetic motion and burst formulas. Added bounded pools, active clocks, event keys, shared sprite output, and a fixed-band 3D view.
